title: The menu bar menu can edit the last capture, and stops offering an empty Preferences
goal: If the capture toast fades before you reach it, editing that capture means opening the history and finding it again. The menu bar menu gains Edit Last Capture with a shortcut. The menu's Preferences item does nothing today and goes away until there is something behind it.
notes: MenuBarMenu (struct MenuBarMenu in Sources/Photonz) carries the dead item 'Button("Preferences…") {}'. AppCoordinator.editCapture(url) and openRecording(url) exist; capture.store holds history newest first. Global hotkeys go through HotkeyCenter; pick a chord that does not collide with shift-command-3, 4, 5 or H. Workflow finding from the manager pass: the toast is the only fast path from capture to editor and it auto-fades.
acceptance: The menu bar menu and the Capture menu both list Edit Last Capture with a global shortcut that opens the most recent screenshot in an editor window (a recording opens the video editor); disabled when history is empty.
Preferences… is gone from the menu bar menu, or opens something real; no dead menu item remains.
Shell code shared by both releases, no flag needed; the log says why.
Audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task.

log.note: Pre-build review: the hotkey is the value, the menu item alone barely beats opening history. Chord is Shift-Command-6: continues the 3/4/5 family, and global Carbon hotkeys pre-empt the app's own key equivalents, so nothing the editor binds (Shift-Command-E is Export) could be reused. Last = whatever history lists first, so menu, hotkey and overlay agree. Preferences removed outright: a disabled placeholder is a promise the app is not keeping.

Built: CaptureCenter registers Shift-Command-6 (onEditLastCapture); AppCoordinator gains lastCapture + editLastCapture() routing recordings to the video editor; MenuBarMenu and the Capture CommandMenu both list Edit Last Capture, disabled when history is empty; Preferences item deleted. Mock docs' menu lists (PRODUCT-MODEL.md, AGENTS.md) updated to match.

Why shared, no flag: the menu bar menu, Capture menu, coordinator and hotkeys are shell code neither release has forked, so Next gets it by construction; a flag would gate a plain menu item with nothing visual to diverge on, and deleting a dead item is a fix Current should have too.

Verified: swift build clean, Scripts/test.sh 1157 tests green, probe app built and launched with no hotkey registration failure in the unified log. Could not press the hotkey or enumerate the live menu: the unmanned terminal has neither Accessibility (synthetic keys dropped, AXIsProcessTrusted false) nor Automation (System Events refused). Recorded in the audit's rough list; the audit's try steps are the live check.
Follow-ups filed: Welcome window warns about the Touch Bar Shift-Command-6 system shortcut; both menus use the same capture command names. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-02-edit-last-capture.json.

Shift-Command-6 global hotkey plus Edit Last Capture in the menu bar menu and the Capture menu open the newest capture (video editor for recordings), disabled when history is empty; dead Preferences item removed. Shared shell code so both releases have it. swift build clean, Scripts/test.sh 1157 tests green, probe app launched cleanly; live hotkey/menu check left to the playtest (no Accessibility/Automation grant here). Audit queue/audits/2026-09-02-edit-last-capture.json.
